name: Port Jefferson
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Port Jefferson 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Port Jefferson, NY for 2026: Dickens Festival, Santa Parade, Festival of Trees and Theatre Three shows.
lede: Port Jefferson is a Christmas destination, with the Dickens Festival, a Santa Parade, a Festival of Trees and two holiday shows at Theatre Three.
celebrates: The Greater Port Jefferson Chamber of Commerce lists the village's season on one page, from the Reindeer Scavenger Hunt that starts November 22 to the Festival of Trees that runs December 1 to January 2. The Santa Parade steps off at 1:30 pm on Sunday, November 29, with Santa at the Village Center afterward. The Charles Dickens Festival fills the village on December 5 and 6, and Theatre Three stages A Christmas Carol and Barnaby Saves Christmas for children. Kids Night Out nights on December 11 and 18 give ages 5 to 10 a Gaga Ball party and a winter crafts party.
lastyear: The chamber calls the 2026 Dickens Festival the 30th annual, so the village has hosted it since the mid 1990s. Earlier round-ups showed conflicting dates for the Festival of Trees, and the chamber's 2026 page and Discover Long Island now agree on December 1 to January 2. We did not find a published 2025 recap of the parade. Because the chamber keeps updating its holiday guide through the season, families should check it for any change in times, especially for the Village Center events.
facts: The Port Jefferson Village Center is at 101A East Broadway and hosts the Festival of Trees, the Santa visit and Kids Night Out. Theatre Three is at 412 Main Street. The chamber's holiday guide is updated through the season, so check it for new dates.
trains: Ride the rails to the holidays. The MTA says the Long Island Rail Road's Holiday Lights Train, a locomotive covered in thousands of lights, runs along all electric branches from Monday, November 23 into January, so families who ride the LIRR this season may spot it. Check the LIRR timetable before you plan a train trip to the events on this page, and bring the children to the window to look for the glowing locomotive.
traditions: A 30th annual village festival with a parade, on December 5 and 6.
The parade steps off at 1:30 pm on Main Street, followed by Santa at the Village Center.
Decorated trees fill two floors of the Village Center.
A Christmas Carol and Barnaby Saves Christmas on Main Street.
Two Friday nights for ages 5 to 10 with pizza parties.
kidfact: Port Jefferson's Reindeer Scavenger Hunt asks children to find every decorative reindeer around the village.
faq: How does Port Jefferson celebrate Christmas?
With a Santa Parade, the Charles Dickens Festival, a Festival of Trees, a reindeer scavenger hunt and holiday shows at Theatre Three, all listed by the Greater Port Jefferson Chamber of Commerce.
When is the Port Jefferson Santa Parade in 2026?
Sunday, November 29, 2026, at 1:30 pm down Main Street, with Santa at the Village Center from about 2 to 4 pm.
When is the Port Jefferson Festival of Trees?
December 1, 2026, to January 2, 2027, at the Port Jefferson Village Center.
sources: Greater Port Jefferson Chamber of Commerce

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Port Jefferson for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, at least 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 22 (the Reindeer Scavenger Hunt, now part of the Santa Parade card) through January 2, 2027 (the Festival of Trees), with the Santa Parade on November 29 and the Charles Dickens Festival on December 5 and 6. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
